title: Fixed Lobed Chamber And Curved Triangle Rotor Display
description: One newly authored complete fixed lobed-chamber and triangular-rotor illustrative display. Neither old source meshes nor component coordinates are imported. Four constant opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. One prop zero scenes. Deliberate fixed static joins and visible air gaps only. The outline is an artistic schematic, not a working epitrochoid or manufactured rotor profile.
